nodes.name: Lead Webhook
nodes.notes: POST JSON: { name, email, company, message }. Responds immediately so the form never waits on enrichment.

nodes.name: Normalize Lead
nodes.notes: Trim everything, lowercase the email, split the full name, and pull the domain out once so scoring and enrichment both reuse it.

nodes.name: Enrich Contact
nodes.notes: Swap in Clearbit / Apollo / your provider. Credential goes on this node — never inline in the URL. The error output is wired so a dead enrichment vendor cannot drop a lead.

nodes.name: Enrichment Unavailable
nodes.notes: Degrade, don't drop. The lead continues to scoring with enriched=false and simply misses the enrichment points.

nodes.name: Flatten Enrichment
nodes.notes: Every provider nests its payload differently. Normalize here so the scoring rules only ever read flat fields.

nodes.name: Score Lead
nodes.notes: Rules, not an LLM: auditable, free, instant. Reasons ride along with the lead so the score can be defended.

nodes.name: Route by Score
nodes.notes: Rules are evaluated top-down, so the >=40 rule only ever sees leads that already failed >=70. The fallback output catches everything under 40.

nodes.name: Notify Sales Channel
nodes.notes: Swap in your Slack / Cliq / Teams incoming-webhook URL. Store it as a credential or an environment variable, not in the node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ email: $json.email, first_name: $json.first_name, last_name: $json.last_name, company: $json.company, source: 'website-form', score: $json.score, score_reasons: $json.score_reasons, status: 'hot' }) }}

nodes.name: Upsert CRM Record
nodes.notes: Upsert on email, not create. Re-submitting the same form twice should update one record, not open two.

nodes.name: Add to Nurture Sequence
nodes.notes: No human is paged for this band. Swap in Mailchimp / HubSpot / your ESP.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ received_at: $json.received_at, email: $json.email, company: $json.company, score: $json.score, band: $json.band, score_reasons: $json.score_reasons.join('; ') }) }}

nodes.name: Append to Lead Log
nodes.notes: Swap in Google Sheets / Postgres / your warehouse. Low-scoring leads are still recorded — you cannot tune a scoring rule you never measured.
